title: How Many Americans Will Be Arrested While You Are Reading This Article?

content_html_sanitized:
Well, it depends on how fast you can read, but an American, right here in the land of the free and the home of the brave, is arrested every two minutes for possession of marijuana, usually a misdemeanor amount.

 

From NORML.ORG

30 Million Marijuana Arrests and Counting – Enough is Enough!

And

From The ACLU:

Extreme Racial Disparities Persist In Marijuana Arrests

And

Long-Term Mental Health Consequences of Being Arrested on Arrestees and Their Families

And from 1999

Drug Free America Foundation Issues The First Prohibitionist Press

Release Using The IOM Report To Justify Arresting the Sick and Dying: "Smoking Marijuana is Not Medicine."

 

Meanwhile, the Left has been rightly concerned about racism in law enforcement, but not about marijuana prohibition, because Obama is a Prohibitionist.

Obama Flip-Flops On Decrim. Shame on Him, Or Shame on Us? Why Do Politicians Fear Something A Huge Majority Supports? Who Is Their Real Constituency?

And then Biden…

Biden Sort of Decides On Marijuana Legalization: He Is Sort of Still Against It

 

The Right is concerned about government control of medicine, but not about marijuana Prohibition, because The Heritage Foundation tells them what to think about everything.

The Heritage Foundation Uses The Florida Drug Czar To Lie To Conservatives About Medical Marijuana. Very Badly.

And

How The Heritage Foundation Used Newsweek to Recycle Lies About My “Medical Marijuana Scam”

And

Heritage and Harvard and the War on Truth and Freedom

And

Project 2025 is a product of the Heritage Foundation, one of Washington's most prominent right-wing think tanks.

 

There is no mention of marijuana in the text of The 2025

manifesto. But.. it’s a part of their “Heritage”, so to speak.

 

My point is that both the Right and the Left prattle about “freedom” and limited government and law enforcement and minority rights, and medical care, etc. But ignoring 200,000 arrests every year rather undermines their credibility.

See

Cannabis and Democracy: Who Are Our Leaders Following? It Ain't Us!

And from Ibsen’s Enemy of the People: “The strongest man in the world is he who stands most alone.”

 

Or, as we might say these days, “It’s better to stand alone than to pose for a selfie.”
